decision: Accept the frozen per-part snapshot as open-source reference geometry; no production assembly procedure, stock or clearance approval.

snapshot.decision: Accept frozen part snapshot for open-source reference geometry; validation signatures reproduce the prior acquisition-bound full STEP. General exporter hardening and documentation adapter remain separate.

comparison_to_acquisition_bound_full_ste.method: One-to-one centroid/bounds/volume signature comparison; ties within 1e-6 mm centroid resolved by bounds then volume. Not a surface-distance proof.

freecad_reference_save_reopen.qualification: Generated reference with imported shapes/placements; no native constraints, design approval or assembly procedure.

limitations: STEP geometry has no Inventor constraints or feature history. Native parameter authoring was separately demonstrated by the monitor fixture.
Per-body overlap was not established; FreeCAD and Inventor volume integration still differs for one purchased multibody part. Do not use these models as certified mass-property data.
Raw scene.json is not accepted by current mechanical-docs draft-1 loader: IDs, metadata and basis require an adapter.
FreeCAD imports STEP in mm; documentation meshing must not scale returned coordinates as though still in header units.

Current Export-PartAssets.ps1 is a scoped prototype; it lacks general strict hash/ref/state/collision enforcement. All 37 part and root hashes were independently verified for this snapshot, but intermediate assembly hashes were not rerecorded in this run.
All native automation ran in a logged-in Windows desktop; no Vault writes or service-mode qualification.
